mapper.insert: INSERT INTO card( member_id, card_company, card_name, card_number, card_type ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{cardCompany}, #{cardName}, #{cardNumber}, #{cardType} )
mapper.select: SELECT card_id, member_id, card_company, card_name, card_number, card_type, created_at FROM card WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
